verdict.rationale: incident.io's own docs show schedule building with rotations and chosen participants. Its marketing claims support for shadow schedules and follow-the-sun configurations, which suggests time-zone-based coverage, and imported holidays appear alongside shifts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of schedule layers, explicit time-zone configuration per rotation, round-robin coverage, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build on-call schedules with rotations, layers, time zones, and round-robin coverage that match how my teams actually work
